Andrew Jaspan is a British-Australian journalist and co-founder of The Daily Source, a not-for-profit media outlet that publishes community-driven news articles focusing on local issues.
Background of Andrew Jaspan
Andrew Jaspan was born on April 20, 1952, and has had a distinguished career in journalism. He has served as the editor-in-chief of several prominent publications, including Melbourne's The Age and London's The Observer. His extensive experience in the media industry has shaped his vision for a new kind of journalism that emphasizes academic expertise and research. Wikipedia
The Daily Source
The Daily Source was co-founded by Andrew Jaspan and Jack Rejtman in March 2011. It operates as a network of nonprofit media outlets that aims to provide high-quality, community-focused journalism. The platform allows journalists to write articles that address local concerns, ensuring that important issues are presented in an accessible manner. Wikipedia
